label: Power Factor
description: Total power factor; sign follows Var

label: Daily Energy
description: AC energy produced since local midnight

label: DC Voltage
description: DC input voltage (single MPPT) or DC bus voltage

label: MPPT n DC Current
description: Per-MPPT/port or per-string DC current; repeat n=1..N

label: DC Nameplate
description: Installed DC capacity (Wp) behind this inverter

label: Active Fault Code
description: Vendor fault code; 0 = no fault; decode from vendor manual

label: Throttle Percent
description: Current output limitation as % of WMaxRtg

label: Throttle Source
description: What is limiting output right now

label: Available Active Power
description: Power the inverter could produce without curtailment

label: Curtailment Limit W
description: Caps output in W (for devices that take W instead of %)

label: PF Setpoint
description: Fixed power factor magnitude while injecting W
